title: Crash when adding AnimationTree to a scene
body:
### Tested versions

- Found in 4.7-rc1
- Untested in other versions

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc1 - Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) 13 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 (RADV NAVI22) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700G with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 31.21 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Done in Godot 4.7-rc1, Linux x64 build thru Wayland. New project and scene without any scripts yet, only a Blender model and some IK solvers. I was testing some sorta complicated IK behaviors when on trying to add an AnimationTree to the scene, the engine crashed. On trying again I realized it's crashing every time I add an AnimationTree anywhere in the scene - specifically an AnimationTree, not any other node type that I can find. Upon further testing it seems to crash when adding that type of node in ANY scene, not just the one I had used it in. Decided to open the engine in a terminal to get a crash message.

As far as I'm aware I've done nothing to cause the engine to crash - again, the project has no scripts, and uses solely built-in node types being used in what I can only assume is their intended use cases. No add-ons either; purely the vanilla engine.

- Open up a project
- Add an AnimationTree node anywhere in a scene
- That's about it, as far as I can tell
